place._theme: A quiet (non-hostile) site and an unmanned array. Abandoned-only was a pool of 4 (lint, 2026-10-17), too narrow. The board places the POI, so it always starts (his, 2026-10-12). Open, not mine: shooting at a site with residents (52a's fire burned a worker, 10-27).

prose.name: Sabotage: Ecliptic Scanners on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The Ecliptic have a scanner array at the <Place> watching everything that moves on <Planet>. The settlers who posted the job want every scanner in it destroyed.
prose.card: Local Contract. The Ecliptic are watching <Planet> through a scanner array at the <Place>. We need it destroyed, all of it, so they have to send someone out to look for themselves. Payment on completion.

recap: The Ecliptic scanners at the <Place> are wrecked, all three. Whatever the mercenaries want to know about <Planet> now, they'll have to come and see it with their own eyes.
recapSay: Their screens all went dark at once, and we had everything moved before they'd worked out it wasn't a fault.

beats.objective: Destroy the Ecliptic scanners at the <Place>
beats.journal: This scanner was tracking movement on the ground. It isn't tracking anything now.
beats.name: Ecliptic Motion Scanner

beats.journal: This one counted ships landing and taking off. Whoever's watching will have to count them by eye.
beats.name: Ecliptic Landing Scanner

beats.journal: This scanner logged heat signatures, and it's in pieces now, still warm.
beats.name: Ecliptic Thermal Scanner

broadcast: You took our job? Then break every one of them, because a single scanner left standing is enough to see us coming.
_speech: The issuer on the radio once the job is taken. Voice is 05a and 18a's (wCizWKvnaS3LOIUwHo98); his ear decides. Radio rules: no names, no places, no factions spoken, no currency.
